name: DiffusionGemma 26B A4B
short: Google's experimental open-weights text-diffusion MoE (25.2B/3.8B active, 256K, Apache 2.0) for fast local generation/OCR/infilling - Google says quality is below Gemma 4.
contextWindow: 256K total (1,024-token sliding window, 256-token canvas; no max-output figure published)
modalities: Text, image in; text out (video supported as sampled frames, max 60s at 1 fps)
pricingNote: Apache 2.0 open weights (self-host $0); hosted $0-$0.50 per 1M in/out
freeTierNote: Apache 2.0 open weights self-host $0; NVIDIA NIM serves $0/$0
standout: The on-device speed play: 1,000-1,500 tok/s text diffusion with bidirectional editing and infilling in one 25B checkpoint.
tradeoff: Google states plainly that diffusion output quality is below standard Gemma 4 - GPQA 73.2 vs 82.3, MMMU-Pro 54.3 vs 73.8, MRCR 32.0 vs 44.1.
